description: This Java class provides validation utilities for elements within a mini-language framework, including attribute and child element validation, handling of deprecated attributes, and script detection.

classes.name: MiniLangValidate
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for validation of XML elements in a mini-language context.

methods.name: attributeNames
methods.description: Validates that the element's attributes match a list of valid attribute names.

methods.name: checkAttribute
methods.description: Returns attribute value if not empty; otherwise, returns a default value.

methods.name: childElements
methods.description: Validates that the element's child elements match a list of valid child element names.

methods.name: constantAttributes
methods.description: Ensures specified attributes contain only constant values, not expressions.

methods.name: constantPlusExpressionAttributes
methods.description: Checks that attributes contain constant values with optional expressions, without scripts.

methods.name: deprecatedAttribute
methods.description: Detects deprecated attributes and suggests fixes.

methods.name: expressionAttributes
methods.description: Validates that specified attributes are of expression type and do not contain scripts.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles validation errors by throwing or logging warnings depending on the validation level.

methods.name: lenientOn
methods.description: Determines if validation is in lenient mode based on properties.

methods.name: noChildElements
methods.description: Ensures that the element has no child elements.

methods.name: requireAnyAttribute
methods.description: Validates that at least one attribute from a set is present.

methods.name: requireAnyChildElement
methods.description: Checks that at least one child element from a set is present.

methods.name: requiredAttributes
methods.description: Ensures that all specified attributes are present.

methods.name: requiredChildElements
methods.description: Ensures that all specified child elements are present.

methods.name: scriptAttributes
methods.description: Validates that specified attributes contain scripts appropriately formatted.

methods.name: strictOn
methods.description: Checks if validation is in strict mode.

methods.name: validationOn
methods.description: Checks if validation level is lenient or strict.
